# HandleDownloadedMessages requests filtering rather than certifying download success

The message channel calls HandleDownloadedMessages after a successful fetch, before reading the stored message. The autosync callback calls it whenever the folder query succeeds, without checking fetch status first, and separately passes that status to OnDownloadCompleted. The folder method starts another filtering pass. A queued message whose incoming filters need its body remains queued while its Offline flag is absent. Keep that notification distinct from fetch success or proof that every message body exists. The owned interface rename preserves these caller roles; the accepted source also supports Graph in autosync. No download or filter test was run.

Scope: Exchange folder offline-download notification callers.
